Summary: “Whose dads did Theo catch smooching?” Chimney slides into the chair across from them, an easy smile stretching across his face. Buck chooses that exact moment to appear at the top of the loft stairs, freezing as soon as Chim’s words leave his mouth. Chimney glances around the group, clearly waiting for a continuation of the station gossip. His grin fades as he slowly takes in the silence, gears turning as he clocks the red staining Eddie’s cheeks and the way Buck’s jaw unhinges itself and hangs slack. “Oh my fucking god.” He deadpans. “Theo caught you two –” “No, we weren’t –” Eddie tries, desperately throwing himself in front of the avalanche of lies that is quickly picking up speed and swallowing up everyone in its path. “Eddie!” Buck interrupts, so shrill and sharp that everyone in the vicinity freezes and stares. “Can I talk to you over here, please?”Theo mishears Eddie accusing Buck of "mooching" and accidentally sets fire to Eddie's plan to 1) come out and 2) tell Buck that he's in love with him. Miscommunication and a brief fake-dating stint ensue.
